Container.Name: pocket-tts-german-wyoming
Container.Overview: Native Rust German Pocket TTS server with Wyoming protocol support for Home Assistant. CPU-only streaming TTS: German/de-DE, 24 kHz mono PCM16 LE, Q8 by default, 27 official German voice states and configurable speech speed. Models and voices are downloaded from pinned official sources when missing and persist across restarts. Compatible local assets can be installed manually. No Python, PyTorch or GPU runtime. Add Wyoming Protocol manually in Home Assistant using the host address and Wyoming port. This template prepares a future registry release; no public image or CA listing is currently claimed.
Container.Requires: linux/amd64 with Gracemont-compatible AVX2 CPU; tested on Intel N100. Dedicated models and voices directories must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100. First initialization needs Internet access unless compatible local assets are installed. No Web UI.

Config.Name: Wyoming Port
Config.Description: Wyoming TCP port for Home Assistant. Container port remains 10204.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Dedicated persistent models directory. Must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100; existing user files are not overwritten.

Config.Name: Voices
Config.Description: Dedicated persistent voices directory. Must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100; existing user files are not overwritten.

Config.Name: Model language
Config.Description: Only german is supported; Wyoming advertises de-DE.

Config.Name: Local model path
Config.Description: Optional compatible model path inside the container. When set, no automatic model download or replacement occurs.

Config.Name: Models directory
Config.Description: Persistent model root. Keep aligned with the models volume target.

Config.Name: Voices directory
Config.Description: Persistent official and local voice root. Keep aligned with the voices volume target.

Config.Name: Default voice
Config.Description: Default voice name. 27 pinned official German voices plus compatible local states are discovered at startup. See README and assets/german-voices.lock.json.

Config.Name: Q8 quantization
Config.Description: true uses Q8; false uses FP32. Q8 derivatives are stored separately; the original model is never overwritten.

Config.Name: CPU threads
Config.Description: Backend threads: 1 to 4. Intel N100 tested with 2.

Config.Name: German normalization
Config.Description: Native German SPAN/Priority normalization before the Pocket TTS tokenizer.

Config.Name: Speech Speed
Config.Description: Speech speed / Sprechgeschwindigkeit. Valid range: 0.8–1.2; default: 1.0. Intermediate values allowed. Invalid values cause a startup error; no clamping.

Config.Name: Wyoming listen port
Config.Description: Container listen port. Keep 10204 to match the port mapping; change only the host port when necessary.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: error, warn, info, debug or trace. INFO currently logs input, normalized and tokenizer text; use warn for privacy.

Config.Name: Voice cache MiB
Config.Description: Lazy voice LRU budget: 16–512 MiB. Not a total-process RAM limit.

Config.Name: Download official voices
Config.Description: Automatically download missing pinned public official voice states. Existing valid states are reused; local states are not overwritten.
